Calm blue water holds an expansive classical garden floating as a dreamlike group of irregular islands. A soft pink-blue sky meets a hazy mountainous horizon. Glossy reflections, bright sunlit masonry, lush saturated grass, and occasional elevated trellises give the place its serene, ornate, slightly fantastical atmosphere.

The tightly woven, rectilinear core opens into broad, organically curved lawns at the perimeter. Between them, pale stone walkways, courtyards, canals, ponds, bridges, terraces, and low interconnected garden structures form a dense but orderly network. Peach and cream stucco carries pink stone trim and decorative bands, with fluted columns, brick-lined arches, balustrades, and occasional pergolas draped in vines and hanging purple flowers. Most structures remain low walls, arcades, gateways, covered passages, and rounded pavilions rather than enclosed multistory buildings, clustered along waterways and facing gardens or pools.

Narrow turquoise canals and rounded lily ponds thread throughout the complex, passing beneath small bridges, raised archways, and open colonnades; several short waterfalls or spillways link levels. Wide pale cobbled promenades and curving retaining walls trace the main landmass, leaving water-filled inlets between projecting garden lobes. Offshore, several detached circular pavilion islands rise in concentric grassy terraces, arched perimeter walls enclosing a small domed open gazebo at each crown.

Clipped hedges, flower beds, topiary, tall slender trees, willows, flowering trees, shrubs, urn planters, and scattered circular planting beds fill the lawns. Their planting is formal yet varied, lending order to the gardens while retaining their variety.

Calm blue water holds an expansive classical garden floating as a dreamlike group of irregular islands. A soft pink-blue sky meets a hazy mountainous horizon. Glossy reflections, bright sunlit masonry, lush saturated grass, and occasional elevated trellises give the place its serene, ornate, slightly fantastical atmosphere.

The tightly woven, rectilinear core opens into broad, organically curved lawns at the perimeter. Between them, pale stone walkways, courtyards, canals, ponds, bridges, terraces, and low interconnected garden structures form a dense but orderly network. Peach and cream stucco carries pink stone trim and decorative bands, with fluted columns, brick-lined arches, balustrades, and occasional pergolas draped in vines and hanging purple flowers. Most structures remain low walls, arcades, gateways, covered passages, and rounded pavilions rather than enclosed multistory buildings, clustered along waterways and facing gardens or pools.

Narrow turquoise canals and rounded lily ponds thread throughout the complex, passing beneath small bridges, raised archways, and open colonnades; several short waterfalls or spillways link levels. Wide pale cobbled promenades and curving retaining walls trace the main landmass, leaving water-filled inlets between projecting garden lobes. Offshore, several detached circular pavilion islands rise in concentric grassy terraces, arched perimeter walls enclosing a small domed open gazebo at each crown.

Clipped hedges, flower beds, topiary, tall slender trees, willows, flowering trees, shrubs, urn planters, and scattered circular planting beds fill the lawns. Their planting is formal yet varied, lending order to the gardens while retaining their variety.
